winning_patterns.evidence: Video 'or5gtaBpRVY' about husband-wife dynamics got 1666 views, significantly higher than any other video.
winning_patterns.action: Focus more heavily on relatable marital and close relationship realities.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Aakhri Baar Jab Tumne Usse Dekha Tha...' (KDy9RCRdVR8) only got 22 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly poetic or niche situational hooks that lack broad immediate relatability.
